productionActions: Use a BaoTa finite task to back up redis.conf, apply the exact persistence and limit directives, validate redis-server --test-memory is not used as a config substitute, and restart only the BaoTa Redis service
After restart verify PING, AOF and RDB status, maxmemory, maxclients, noeviction, scoped set get ttl delete, API readiness and existing Worker Crawler health
On failure restore the backed-up redis.conf and restart Redis through BaoTa before dependent services resume
rollback: Restore the exact BaoTa Redis configuration backup, restart the BaoTa Redis service, verify persistence plus scoped read/write cleanup, and preserve failure evidence. Never FLUSHALL or wildcard-delete keys.
